outer_valence_shell.name: Outer Valence Shell (n = 3)
outer_valence_shell.description: Outermost occupied electron energy level containing the valence electrons that determine chemical reactivity and bonding.

inner_core_shell.name: Second Energy Level (n = 2 Core Shell)
inner_core_shell.description: Inner core electron shell holding up to 8 electrons (2s²2p⁶) closer to the nucleus than the valence shell.

proton_nucleon.name: Proton (Positively Charged Nucleon, p⁺)
proton_nucleon.description: Positively charged subatomic particle in the nucleus whose count defines the element's atomic number (Z).

atomic_nucleus.name: Central Atomic Nucleus
atomic_nucleus.description: Dense, positively charged central core of the atom containing protons and neutrons (nucleons) and nearly all atomic mass.

first_energy_level.name: First Energy Level (n = 1 Innermost K-Shell)
first_energy_level.description: Lowest-energy electron shell closest to the nucleus, holding a maximum of 2 paired electrons (1s²).

neutron_nucleon.name: Neutron (Neutral Nucleon, n⁰)
neutron_nucleon.description: Uncharged subatomic particle in the nucleus that contributes to mass number (A) and varies between isotopes of the same element.

valence_electron.name: Valence Electron (e⁻)
valence_electron.description: Negatively charged subatomic particle occupying the outermost energy shell that is shared or transferred during chemical bonding.
